en: This is an old postage stamp, not a postcard. The image features a traditional Moorish architectural gate or entrance with people in North African attire, some on foot and one on horseback. The design is intricate, with arabesque decorative elements. The text on the stamp includes 'MARRUECOS', 'PROTECTORADO ESPAÑOL', Arabic script, and '10 CTS'. The bottom mentions 'TETUAN' and the producer 'WATERLOW & SONS, LIMITED, LONDRES' along with 'M. BERTYUCHI'.
